coordinate_contract.method: Replay root sequence records through named label; PlaceObject2 move preserves prior depth state, new placement resets it, RemoveObject removes. Compose child first local sequence affine with ancestors; bounds from table3 rectangle union or table4 text header.
limits: No ActionScript/GoToLabel execution or child timeline advancement. These are first-local-frame static carrier compositions, not final rendered screenshots.
Text bounds are layout bounds, not glyph ink, baseline, or guaranteed number of rendered lines.
image_id=4294967295 is vector/solid/mask data and is not a missing raster filename.

Native resource transforms remain separate: 357880 calls 4ab510 with float32.0 (4ba190 stores it at+0x10; meaning not proven) and 4ab210 with0/400; 4ab210 body absent. Do not identify those constants as font size or apply an invented screen translation.
Source and own projection rectangles are deliberately separate; letterbox/crop, pixel alpha padding and own font metrics require native implementation validation.

normal_hero_selection.ordinary_window_fl_out_cases: Same 998/-1 then protagonist+bank!=999 then normal split: fl_out/fl_hero_out/fl_nomal_out.
normal_hero_selection.name_resource_in: Separately chooses fl_hero_in_1 when speaker_id==saved_current_protagonist_id, otherwise window chosen in-label. Its out-label additionally requires bank!=999 for fl_hero_out_1.
normal_hero_selection.event_mode: When manager+0x960==1 and requested window mode0, mode becomes1. Event resource at+0x504 uses its own fl_in/out and can use fl_out_2 when both name banks have no name (998/-1).
normal_hero_selection.own_adaptation: Map explicit own current protagonist identity and explicit speaker/display-name metadata. A fixed own name such as Mio, an empty speaker string or monologue classification alone is not proof of the original hero branch.
normal_hero_selection.transition_limit: Full requested/previous display ID and name-bank checks remain in native358790; transition summary is not a replacement for its guards. Fast mode4784e0 snaps to wait/stop labels and binds immediately.

name_content_and_first_glyph.resource_binding: 358790 loads flash/adv/spcpack/chara_name_%s.spc, member chara_name_%03d.spc, texture.srd, replaces name SFL image slots0 and1. Different requested/previous names use two bank slots.
name_content_and_first_glyph.content_type: Raster replacement in table3 image shape; not a text4 speaker-name label.
name_content_and_first_glyph.finding: No UTF8 first-character split or separate colored first glyph layer in these SFLs/native functions. Name SFL has a single image0 quad. Visible first-glyph styling could be baked in the missing per-character raster; exact main-name raster colors remain unknown.
name_content_and_first_glyph.own_NameHead_status: Own full-name text plus first-codepoint overlay/color is an adaptation, not established native behavior. Reusing a colored first-character overlay requires own deliberate art policy, not a V3 evidence claim.
name_content_and_first_glyph.stale_name_lifecycle: When transition pending(+0x9d0),357880 waits name-resource(+0x508) readiness, replaces texture slot0, releases old bank, clears obsolete IDs/pending state. Own choice/nameless states should clear both visible label and backing image/text state.
name_content_and_first_glyph.backlog_limit: Provided common_backlog_JP name rasters are512x64 and sampled glyph RGB is white with varying alpha. Main adv_window_name_US shape uses455x65. Neither filename similarity nor white backlog pixels proves same main-name styling.

text_and_color.header_default_description: Static text headers in these sampled carriers use white; ancestor color chain retained per leaf.
text_and_color.font_limit: These are transformed nominal axes. Actual own typeface ascent/descent/ink and native glyph metrics are not solved by choosing this point size.
text_and_color.native_reset: 359480 resets output and writes UTF16 <CLT=cltNORMAL>.3594f0 consumes source units and copies control tags without spending ordinary glyph reveal budget.
text_and_color.palette_token_mapping_limit: 472ec0 is another cached script-text consumer; IDs are token/style indices, not RGB values or proof that ordinary ADV uses the identical final palette. Cache contains no cltMONO literal. Exact normal/mind colors remain unknown.
text_and_color.own_adaptation: Default white follows header; authored per-line/inline style needs explicit metadata. Do not infer blue solely from an empty speaker and call it original behavior.

read_wait_next_connection.start: 358660 clears/reinitializes reveal, assigns source(+0x930) and reveal parameter(+0x940).357880 asynchronously loads5 UI handles(+0x500..+0x510), waits resource states, then begins window state.
read_wait_next_connection.wait: Reveal-complete(+0x944) and BTN-wait(+0x954) gate waiting state3. Page indicator resource+0x50c selects fl_in or fl_auto_in and world+0xab64 becomes1.
read_wait_next_connection.indicator_geometry: Manual fl_wait uses page arrow shape source[1739,965,42,42]; original texture32x32 maps to42x42 SFL quad. Own projection[1159.333333,643.333333,28,28].
read_wait_next_connection.auto: Auto budget is displayed units*2 for language2/3, otherwise*4, plus120. Voice-busy reduces allowed threshold with a minimum60; timing is native update units, not a claim of seconds.
read_wait_next_connection.accept: Manual acceptance playsSE003; indicator usesfl_ok unless auto/programmatic. State4 and script delay are set, world+0xab64 cleared. Wait for indicator ready or fast-mode path, reset text, release script busy47bfb0(0), stopvoice545040.
read_wait_next_connection.visibility: 357880 hides/restores UI around world+0xab60 and pod/menu state+0xab50. Next is not an always-visible decoration while text is still revealing.
read_wait_next_connection.input_limit: Logical advance/auto/fast mode gates established; physical keyboard/mouse remapping belongs to own mapping and is not asserted by these function names.

mode_and_visual_branches.ordinary_vs_trial: 35efa0 mode0 routes353070->358660;mode1 routes362e90->364840;mode2 routes443d80 (body absent here);mode3 routes399170.46b8e0 LOC saved+16a4 values1/3/5 use35ef60 then35efa0;2 uses42f3c0 then42f3d0->437c60.437c60 resets439010 and sets source+d50/param+d60 before439080.
mode_and_visual_branches.trial_binding_limit: Resolved controller/resource distinction is now in trial_dialogue_binding; higher own task mapping of saved16ae/16e0 and full dynamic child execution remain separate.
mode_and_visual_branches.source_scope: Day labels are first-local-frame child state; night/close variants and replacement slots exist. All gameplay states do not share one literal day texture.

provided_raster_inventory.ordinary_frame_namebase_page: No matching ordinary_window/event_window/speaker_name/page_indicator container in this provided manifest. Existing SRD metadata records texture names, sizes and unavailable external srdv ranges. No pixels were newly extracted.
provided_raster_inventory.fallback_boundary: Use native geometry as layout evidence; an own redraw of missing panel/namebase/page art must be described as reconstruction, not identical recovered raster. Provided backlog name PNGs are a separate resource purpose.
